129565.overview:
Acornsoft Life is an implementation of Conway's Game of Life. The player draws patterns by moving a cursor over the screen and upon pressing the return key the patterns will start to evolve based on three rules:

-    If an empty square is surrounded by exactly three organisms a new one is born.
-    If an organism is surrounded by four or more organisms it dies of overcrowding.
-    If an organism has less that one neighbour it dies of loneliness.

There are seven predefined pattern that the player can add in any orientation to any position of the screen:

-    Glider which moves diagonally
-    Small spaceship which moves horizontally or vertically
-    Flying machine which moves horizontally or vertically
-    Glider gun which fire out gliders
-    Queen bee which is an oscillating shape
-    15 cycle which is an oscillator with a period of 15
-    Eater which eats various small blocks of life

460508.overview:
Grand Prix Special, also known as "Lemans" is a racing game set on a simplified track where the player controls a car competing in time-limited heats. There is no narrative framing or backstory; the game focuses entirely on reflex-based driving within a constrained display area. The title was included as a type-in program in the book "Getting Acquainted with Your Acorn Atom".

Players steer a car vertically up the screen while avoiding barriers and staying within the track. Controls use the CTRL key to steer left and SHIFT to steer right. The player selects a difficulty factor (1–5) at the start of each session, which influences gameplay speed or responsiveness. Points are awarded based on performance during each race segment, with a cumulative score displayed at the end. A high score is tracked between sessions, and players can immediately begin a new race.
